definitions.explanation: Used to emphasize that something is exactly as described or expected.
Suggesting something appears to be a certain way, sometimes implying it's not genuine.

examples.japanese: {如何|いか}にも⟦{彼|かれ}→かれ：01292_kare⟧⟦らしい→らしい：09502_rashii⟧。
{如何|いか}にも⟦{日本|にほん}→にほん：03876_nihon⟧⟦らしい→らしい：09502_rashii⟧⟦{風景|ふうけい}→ふうけい：03591_fuukei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{如何|いか}にも⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→かのじょ：01286_kanojo⟧⟦らしい→らしい：09502_rashii⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→はつげん：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦{笑|わら}った→わらう：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: It was such a typical thing for her to say that everyone laughed.

examples.japanese: {如何|いか}にも⟦{怪|あや}しい→あやしい：10267_ayashii⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→おとこ：00561_otoko⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{如何|いか}にも⟦{嘘|うそ}っぽい→うそっぽい：noentry⟧⟦{話|はなし}→はなし：01496_hanashi⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It was a story that sounded obviously fake.

examples.japanese: {如何|いか}にも⟦{高|たか}そうな→たかそう：noentry⟧⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}た→きる：00541_kiru⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→だんせい：01655_dansei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{自信|じしん}→じしん：10143_jishin⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はな}し→はなす：00467_hanasu⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→はじめる：18370_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: A man wearing a seemingly expensive suit began speaking with great confidence.

notes:
{如何|いか}にも is an adverb meaning "truly," "indeed," or "seemingly," emphasizing typicality.

WRITING:
Usually written in hiragana (いかにも). The kanji {如何|いか} is rarely used.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {如何|いか}にも〜⟦らしい→らしい：09502_rashii⟧: so typical of ~, very ~ -like
- {如何|いか}にも〜⟦そうだ→そうだ：10076_souda⟧: really looks like ~
- {如何|いか}にも⟦{怪|あや}しい→あやしい：10267_ayashii⟧: really suspicious-looking

USAGE:
Emphasizes that something perfectly matches expectations or stereotypes. Can be:
- Positive: {如何|いか}にも⟦{日本|にほん}→にほん：03876_nihon⟧⟦らしい→らしい：09502_rashii⟧ (quintessentially Japanese)
- Negative: {如何|いか}にも⟦{嘘|うそ}っぽい→うそっぽい：noentry⟧ (looks obviously fake)
- Neutral: {如何|いか}にも⟦{彼|かれ}→かれ：01292_kare⟧⟦らしい→らしい：09502_rashii⟧ (so typical of him)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧: exactly, precisely
- ⟦{本当|ほんとう}に→ほんとうに：04714_hontouni⟧: really, truly
- いかにも (without も): how, in what way
